paragraphs.body: Yahoo Sports reports that Jayson Tatum continues to make history in the early going for the Boston Celtics. NBC Sports notes Tatum scored a game-high 32 points against the Orlando Magic. FantasyPros highlights that Tatum flirts with a triple-double in Friday's win over the Chicago Bulls. MassLive and Reuters both identify Tatum as the Celtics' key player in their victory over the Orlando Magic, with Reuters adding this marks the fifth straight win for the team.

headline: Jayson Tatum leads Boston Celtics to fifth straight win with historic early-season performance.
